notes:
Profile: Stratalite Relevance — mid-market B2B SaaS (product search + knowledge layer for their enterprise customers). Evaluating Redwood to replace a brittle two-stage pipeline (BM25 + lightweight ML reranker) with a hosted neural reranking endpoint and, if POC successful, migrate to Dedicated for predictable throughput and isolation.

Recent timeline (short bullets):
- 2025-11-10: inbound signup, initial discovery by AE (Alex) — product team described pain around inconsistent relevance for multi-lingual docs.
- 2026-01-15: demo w/ SE (Samira) — showed hosted API reranking endpoint + scoring explanations; PM liked offline scoring hook.
- 2026-02-12: POC kickoff (hosted): provided 3k-query eval set + 50k doc corpus; objective: improve NDCG@5 and reduce support deflection errors. Fireflies: ff_2026-02-12_0930_stratalite-call.
- 2026-02-26: security questionnaire returned; SOC2 requested, KMS integration a hard requirement for production.
- 2026-03-04: pricing + runway review; asked for Dedicated baseline and burst pricing numbers (Fireflies: ff_2026-03-04_1100_pricing-review).

POC details / success metrics: 
- Workload: user-facing search with a reranking layer that re-scores top-k candidates from fast retrieval. Offline scoring for nightly batch re-ranking to refresh personalized results.
- Targets: latency p95 <= 200ms for rerank on 5 candidates; throughput ~50 qps expected during peak for internal cluster; Precision@5 target +10% over baseline, NDCG improvement target +0.06–0.12.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; goal is cost per 1k queries <$20 at initial scale. Prefers starting on hosted to accelerate iteration, then switch to Dedicated once stable.
- Model preferences: open-model preference (Llama-variant / Falcon family) with quantization-friendly inference. Wants ability to pin model versions and fallback to a smaller model when overloaded.

Security & compliance notes: 
- Must meet SOC2 and provide audit-logging for token-level actions.
- SSO/SAML integration needed for all staging/prod test accounts (blocking POC access for some internal stakeholders).
- Data residency: a subset of enterprise customers require EU residency — Stratalite wants routing policy options or Dedicated in EMEA.

Technical requests / feature asks surfaced during POC: 
- Reranking endpoint should support batch/offline scoring API (bulk scoring for nightly jobs) + raw logits and attention to compute confidence features offline.
- Need evaluation tooling: easy import of eval sets and built-in metrics (Precision@k, NDCG), plus regression alerts for prompt/model changes.
- Request for SDK examples for offline scoring + a sample pipeline to compute nightly rerank scores.

Quotes / call snippets: 
- PM (Lena): "We need deterministic fallbacks — if model A degrades we must auto-fail to older model or cached ranks."
- Lead engineer (Tony): "Start on Hosted, validate eval lifts, then show Dedicated numbers for predictable SLA and cost."

Commercial notes: 
- Estimated ARR range: $75k–$250k if Dedicated chosen next quarter.
- Forecast close: 2026-05 (decision driven by EU residency clause + budget committee).
- Competitors in eval: Algolia for speed, Elastic for self-hosted control, Pinecone for vector infra. Stratalite likes Redwood's unified routing and quant recommendations.

Next steps (short): 
- 3/18: Security deep-dive with infra + Redwood solutions (SE + security). Need to provision SAML test org before 3/18.
- Sales: deliver Dedicated pricing tier and burst plan by 3/12.
- Engineering: provide sample offline-scoring SDK snippet and a checklist for model pinning and fallback config.

Blockers (concise): SSO provisioning, EU residency clarity, CFO approval on Dedicated spend.

- Samira to draft POC success doc and share rerank eval script.
- Alex to push Dedicated pricing and contract template to drive.
